title: Social Security impersonation
source_note: A scripted demo call: a fake Social Security officer threatens to suspend benefits and asks for a Social Security number.

segments.speaker: Recipient
segments.text: Hello, this is Mr. Johnson speaking. Who's calling?

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: My name is Officer Miller, and I'm calling from the Social Security Administration.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: We've been trying to reach you, sir. There's been a problem with your social security number.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: It's been compromised and we need to verify some information to secure your account.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: I'm not at liberty to disclose that information over the phone,

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: but I need to confirm your social security number to proceed.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: This is a matter of utmost importance.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: If you don't cooperate, your benefits may be suspended.

segments.speaker: Caller
segments.text: Please state your social security number to proceed.

segments.speaker: Recipient
segments.text: Okay, let me get my card.
